## Purchase information
The store currently instructs customers to request products by email after making a PayPal deposit. Do not infer instant checkout or automatic delivery.

## Status
Items in the “Próximas secciones” area are upcoming, not currently available products. This catalog lists public repositories only; private and unpublished projects are intentionally excluded.
